headline: 影市热作与新剧齐发
summary: 本周电影热作包括《街头霸王》《偷天父子兵》等，新剧《幻视任务》《我的有罪之人》《降世神通：七净土》首播；热播剧《侠探杰克》《母狮》等持续吸睛。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《街头霸王》《偷天父子兵》《鲸口脱险》等本周受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Film highlights: Street Fighter, Thieves and Sons, and Whale Escape draw attention this week.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《幻视任务》《我的有罪之人》《降世神通：七净土》上线。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Vision Quest, My Guilty One, and Avatar: The Seven Havens launch.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧集：《侠探杰克》《魔女嘉莉》《母狮》《绿灯军团》《菜鸟老警》持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: Hot series: Reacher, Carrie, Lioness, Green Lantern Corps, and The Rookie continue airing.

industryHighlights.text: 待映待播：《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《银翼杀手2099》等引发期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Avengers 5, Dune 3, and Blade Runner 2099 spark anticipation.

headlineEn: Hot Films and New Series Arrive
summaryEn: This week's film highlights include Street Fighter and Thieves and Sons, while new series Vision Quest, My Guilty One, and Avatar: The Seven Havens premiere; hit shows Reacher and Lioness remain popular.
